entities.summary: Lady Rose Victoria Birgitte Louise Gilman is a British film art assistant and member of the British royal family. She is the daughter of Prince Richard, Duke of Gloucester, and his wife Birgitte, Duchess of Gloucester. She is 39th in the line of succession to the British throne as of September 2025.
